texture: All texture is procedural CSS, zero image payload. Pixel-art sprites are drawn one CSS box-shadow per pixel: a single 1px×1px element carries a box-shadow list of `col row 0 color` tuples, each tuple one lit pixel of the sprite — the CRT mask is built by the same grid that holds the pixels, so the sprite and the screen share one material. The full-page CRT overlay is two fixed layers: a 2px-tall repeating-linear-gradient scanline grille at 18% dark, and two pseudo-element chromatic-aberration ghosts (cyan-left / magenta-right) on display headings that breathe ±1px on a 6s ease-in-out idle and snap to ±3px on scroll rush, both mix-blend-mode: screen so they only add light. A 2px repeating-conic 'pixel tile' backs the sprite stage. Everything holds still under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: sprite-cycle
motion.value: 2 frames, 0.42s steps(1) — the hero mascot flips between two box-shadow grids (idle pose ↔ blink); rAF-gated, pauses offscreen

motion.name: crt idle breathe
motion.value: aberration ±1px, 6s ease-in-out infinite; the CRT is alive even when you are not scrolling

motion.name: scroll-rush envelope
motion.value: aberration ±3px + ghost opacity 0.9 at full rush (2.4 px/ms), attack 0.16 / release 0.05 per normalized frame; parks below 0.004 energy

motion.name: scanline flicker
motion.value: scanline opacity 0.16 → 0.22 over 4.7s, JS-modulated; reduced-motion = static grille

motion.name: marquee speed
motion.value: 44 px/s at rest → +240 px/s × energy, the chiptune credits scroll

motion.name: lamp breath
motion.value: 2.4s ease-in-out opacity 1 → 0.4 → 1 on the POWER and LIVE lamps

motion.name: card press
motion.value: transform translateY(2px) on :active, no easing — arcade buttons snap

motion.name: focus ring
motion.value: 2px cyan outline + 5px bubblegum halo + 18px cyan glow, instant
